Look at the mess our so-called leaders have gotten us into. Now we are told the government is stepping in by cutting excise duties to shield consumers, but what is the real cost of this pandering? They are sacrificing the vital public revenues that should be keeping our nation secure, maintaining our infrastructure, and supporting the foundations of a stable society. 

Instead of demanding self-reliance and energy independence, we are left completely vulnerable to foreign conflicts and global markets driven by places like Iran and the endless entanglements of the US and Israel. This is the inevitable result of neglecting our borders and tying our economic security to foreign crude oil imports. The looming threat of increased inflation is going to crush low-income households and laborers—the very people who keep this country running while the establishment plays politics. 

If we don't return to strong borders, economic sovereignty, and fiscal responsibility, working-class families will keep paying the price for elite mismanagement. It is past time to put our own nation first, secure our own energy, and stop sacrificing our stability for globalist market games.
